title: GO! GO! TOKYO MER: Kinkyuujitai to Tatakau Nakama-tachi
description:
The live-action Tokyo MER: Hashiru Kinkyuukyuumeishitsu medical drama series got a short anime to commemorate the series' movie announcement. It portrays the characters as animals.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title: Onaka ga Guuguu Island
description:
This is Guuguu Island, a magical island where the Yakiniku King menu items live. Meat, vegetables, mulberries, sweets... there's all kinds of delicious food! Calvin the apprentice galbi has a dream to become "Yakiniku King's most popular menu item"! To achieve that, he is happily flying around the universe with his adorable friends. Will Calvin and his friends be able to become Yakiniku King's most popular menu items? Aim for a delicious serving! Aim for a delicious Yakiniku King!

(Source: YouTube, translated)

title: Princess Catch! Tiniping
description: On the way to an important gathering by train, the Princess Teeniepings suddenly disappeared without a trace! To make matters even more mysterious, a Legend Teenieping appears in a mirror before Romi. Together with the new Royal Teeniepings, a grand mission begins to catch the Princess Teeniepings!

title: Inpuru-kun no Sonzai Shinai Oshigoto
description: The anime is based on temp agency Improve's mascot Inpuru-kun. It centers on Inpuru-kun taking on absurd temp jobs.

title: Metal Cardbot W
description:
Shining friendship and strong claws! Metal Cardbot W!

After the Speranza incident, humans and Metal Cardbots began to coexist on Earth. Jun, a boy chosen by the Metal Breath, and his partner Blue Cop discovered a way for humans and Metal Cardbots to coexist. Then one day, a "Wild Cardbot" appears, holding a 60 million year secret.

Now, a new encounter begins to shake the world.

(Source: Metal Cardbot Wiki)

title: Azarashi no Eru Aru
description:
Two seals, Eru and Aru, spend their days together in a gentle and warm atmosphere. They play at home, relax watching TV, and sometimes get tired from playing and fall asleep.

(Source: U-NEXT, translated)

title: Jiaonang Jihua: Qiji
description:
"Capsules Project" is a collection of domestically produced animated short films created by a professional team with mature animation production experience. With the creative theme of "extreme emotion + independent theme," it does not restrict the creative form, exploring the possibilities of animation together with the team. The aim is to collaboratively create original short films with diverse styles and characteristics, and to help Chinese animators reach the world stage. "Miracle" represents transcending conventions and breaking through limitations to achieve extraordinary success, often accompanied by a sense of mystery that inspires awe and curiosity. What miracles will occur in these 10 stories?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
